title: Washing Hands Before Meals
paragraphs: Sebelum setiap kali makan, Aisha membiasakan diri mencuci tangan dengan teliti, bahkan di hari kerja yang sibuk. "Kebersihan adalah bagian dari iman," begitu kata ibunya dulu, dan kata-kata itu masih terngiang setiap kali. Di kantin kantor, ia menyadari bahwa banyak rekan kerjanya melewatkan langkah sederhana ini, langsung bergegas dari meja kerja menuju barisan makanan. Aisha selalu meluangkan waktu ekstra di wastafel sebelum bergabung dengan mereka.

Suatu minggu, separuh kantor terkena flu yang menyebar cepat saat jam makan siang. Aisha, meski begitu, tetap sehat sepanjang waktu itu, dan seorang rekan bertanya bercanda apa rahasianya terhindar dari flu kantor. Aisha hanya tersenyum dan menjelaskan kebiasaan kecilnya yang konsisten. Ia telah memahami bahwa satu tindakan sederhana, yang diulang tanpa gagal setiap hari, benar-benar bisa menjaga kesehatannya jauh lebih baik dari yang pernah ia duga.
answerKey: Before every meal, Aisha makes a habit of washing her hands carefully, even during a busy workday. "Cleanliness is part of faith," her mother used to say, and the words still come back to her every single time. At the office cafeteria, she notices that many of her colleagues skip this simple step, rushing straight from their desks to the food line. Aisha always takes the extra minute at the sink before joining them. One week, half the office catches a cold that spreads quickly during lunch breaks. Aisha, however, stays healthy throughout, and a colleague jokingly asks her for the secret to avoiding the office cold. Aisha simply smiles and explains her small, consistent habit. She has come to understand that one simple action, repeated without fail every day, can genuinely protect her health far better than she once assumed.
